module: Flowgraph node "im Button" (category repeat_instant, tag imgui): full-width imgui button in the current window. Input "text". Outputs: "down" (pulse on click), "hold" (held, hidden), "up" (released, hidden).
notes: States are detected only while the mouse hovers over the button.

work.desc: Draws the button and updates down/hold/up according to the mouse.
